channel.title: The Clanton Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Clanton Advertiser (clantonadvertiser.com)

item.title: Corley’s brace helps keep Tigers unbeaten, girls grab draw
item.description: Weston Corley’s two goals keep Chilton County boys soccer unbeaten at 5-0, while the Tigers girls earn a draw and continue to create chances in a busy week of matches.

item.title: Gardens of Clanton host Valentine’s Day Celebration for residents
item.description: The Gardens of Clanton marked Valentine’s Day with a resident celebration crowning a king, queen and sweethearts, joined by Clanton Mayor Dr. Jeffrey Price.

item.title: March Madness: Storylines to Watch Before Selection Sunday Sets the 2026 Bracket
item.description: March Madness always delivers uncertainty, and the road to Selection Sunday is no different.

item.title: Blast From the Past takes center stage in McKee Auditorium for annual show
item.description: Blast From the Past returns Feb. 27-March 1 to McKee Auditorium, uniting 113 students from six high schools to perform classics from Elvis to Taylor Swift.

item.title: Thorsby Swedish Festival Organization receives special coin from Swedish Embassy
item.description: Swedish Embassy visits Thorsby, presenting a special ambassador’s coin to the Swedish Festival Committee and recording its Swedish immigrant history.

item.title: Maplesville students visit Auburn for Cattlemen’s Beef Series event
item.description: Maplesville and Dothan FFA students explore Alabama’s beef industry at Auburn, learning production basics and watching a live carcass fabrication demo.

item.title: Carroll Less — Thorsby quarterback takes Advertiser offensive POTY honors
item.description: After leading Thorsby to a 9-2 season with 2,565 yards and 40 TDs, senior QB Braylon Carroll earns The Clanton Advertiser’s 2025 Offensive Player of the Year; full All-Advertiser team inside.

item.title: Column: Guarding Truth Without Losing Tenderness
item.description: April J. Buchanan urges Christians to defend Gospel truth while staying humble, prayerful and tender, letting Scripture first correct their own hearts.

item.title: Thorsby, Verbena receive donation towards art programs from WoodmenLife
item.description: WoodmenLife's Clanton-based Chapter 322 donated $2,000 to Thorsby and Verbena High School art programs to fund supplies for K-6 students.

item.title: Column: Look for the good, you will find it
item.description: A writer reflects on roommates, road trips and Piggly Wiggly parking lots to show how choosing to look for the good can reveal unexpected beauty in everyday life.
